계정 없이 쓰는 iOS 앱입니다. 화면 문구는 한국어, 영어, 日本語를: An iOS app you use without an account. On-screen copy follows Korean, English, and Japanese, matching the device language.
오늘 챙길 일을 카드에 담습니다. 영양제, 체중, 할 일, 독서처럼 종류: Keep what you want to care for today on cards. Pick a kind, such as vitamins, weight, a task, or reading, then mark it done.
Tap a card to write, then mark it complete.
Move through one card at a time, or see several at once.
The pill at the bottom switches between Today and Story.
The day continues as scenes: waking up, breakfast, focus, a walk, reading, rest.
Tap a scene and fill in today's story.
Each scene can hold a note and a task.
You can start from an empty scene.
pokitstory의 글을 앱에서 읽습니다. 마음에 남는 글은 오늘의 주: Read pokitstory in the app. Save a piece you want to keep into Your Day.
Save while you read, and it stays on a scene in Your Day.
Reading needs a connection. Cards and scenes stay on the device.
Records stay on this device. There is no sign-up and no cloud login.
If you delete the app or change devices, the records may not come with you.
